text:
On the keystone of the unsteady arch,
whose stones time had reddened,
a Gothic coat of arms stood out,
roughly carved by a chisel.

Like the plume of its granite helmet,
the ivy hanging all around
shaded the shield, on which a hand
held a heart.

We both stopped to look at it
in the deserted square,
and she said, “That is the perfect emblem
of my constant love.”

Alas, what she told me then was true.
True that she will carry her heart
in her hand... anywhere at all,
but not in her breast.

translation.title: Rhyme XLV: On the Keystone of the Unsteady Arch
